title: Static Info
description: Payload for rsmp/{device-id}/static/info. Published as a retained message. Contains device identity and baseline metadata.

serial_no.description: Serial number or another identifier of the device.

buffer_drops.description: Cumulative count of messages dropped from the offline buffer due to overflow. Updated only on reconnection.

features.description: List of functional features supported by the device (e.g. 'rsmp-4-core', 'rsmp-4-tlc').
